```python
import sys

def main():
    data = list(map(int, sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()))
    if not data:
        return

    n = data[0]
    a = data[1:1 + n]

    pairs = [(a[i], i) for i in range(n)]
    pairs.sort(reverse=True)

    active = [False] * n
    comp = 0
    ans = 1

    i = 0
    while i < n:
        h = pairs[i][0]

        if comp + 1 > ans:
            ans = comp + 1

        j = i
        while j < n and pairs[j][0] == h:
            idx = pairs[j][1]
            active[idx] = True
            comp += 1

            if idx > 0 and active[idx - 1]:
                comp -= 1
            if idx + 1 < n and active[idx + 1]:
                comp -= 1

            j += 1

        if comp + 1 > ans:
            ans = comp + 1

        i = j

    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```
